title: imap/config: passwords stored and compared as plaintext
description: crates/imap/src/config.rs UserCredential.password is a plain String; the config TOML contains cleartext passwords (e.g., 'hunter2' in tests). The reader crate stores bcrypt hashes. If the IMAP config file leaks, all user credentials are immediately exposed. Fix: store bcrypt hashes in IMAP config, same as reader (bcrypt::verify at cost 10+, with spawn_blocking). The divergence between reader (bcrypt) and IMAP (plaintext) also creates operator confusion.
